regime_read: The convergence picture today is narrow and politically flavored: a handful of mega-cap tech/AI names draw multiple independent channels (affiliation, patent, analyst, contract, retail), but most high-scoring clusters are already extended (+35pp+ vs SPY), so the desk's edge is mostly in non-extended semiconductor/memory and industrial laggards where congress/insider/options signals quietly align. Track record is empty, so conviction stays capped.
regime_read_zh: 今天的信号聚合面较窄，且带有政治色彩：少数大型科技/AI标的获得多个独立渠道（关联、专利、分析师、合同、散户）的共振，但多数高分簇已高度超涨（相对标普超35个点以上），因此本台的真实边际更多在于尚未超涨的半导体/存储及工业落后标的，其国会/内部人/期权信号在悄悄地对齐。台内尚无历史战绩，置信度保持克制。

theses.thesis: AMAT is the cleanest actionable alignment in the pack: a 5-channel convergence of analyst_upgrade_cluster, congress_cluster (4 members, $50.7M net buy side), news_sentiment (0.86 bull), patent_cluster (293 patents), and unusual_options (call-skewed OI, p/c 1.07). Critically it is NOT extended — rs_vs_spy_60d is -36.0, so the entry has not been chased. This is a lagging semi-cap-equipment name just as the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act (HR10170) enters the House agenda [bill_catalyst]. The signal isn't a single hiccup; it's a cluster of large players accumulating a name the tape has left behind.
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT 是本组合中最干净的可操作对齐：5 个渠道共振——分析师上调簇、国会簇（4名议员，净买入5070万美元）、新闻情绪（0.86偏多）、专利簇（293项）与非寻常期权（看涨成交活，put/call 1.07）。关键是它并未超涨——60日相对标普仅-36.0，进场点没有被追高。这是一只落后的半导体设备股，而《存储芯片竞争力评估法案》（HR10170）正在众议院议程推进 [bill_catalyst]。这不是单一异动，而是大型资金在悄悄吸纳一只被行情抛下的标的。
second_order: MU — same memory/semi-capex complex; AMAT tools supply memory fabs, so a capex cycle lifts both
NVDA — AI-led semi demand pulls the whole equipment/testing chain
LRCX/KLAC (off-pack peers) — equipment names trade as a group when a capex cycle forms
theses.dissent: Congress positions are disclosed quarterly and may be stale; the options p/c of 1.07 is only mildly bullish and the bull-ratio cluster may simply reflect sell-side catching up to a name that macro has already repriced.

falsifier.text: A printed quarter showing semi-capex orders rolling over, or HR10170/CHIPS-related spending being cut, would break the thesis.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MU is the purest memory-chip read on HR10170, the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act [bill_catalyst]. The cluster shows insider_mspr at 100 (perfect insider buying), a 446-patent cluster, a maxed-out stocktwits_bull ratio (1.0 among 213k watchers), and Ro Khanna's disclosed affiliation [actor:Ro Khanna], all while the stock is -19.6 vs SPY — meaning the retail/smart-money enthusiasm hasn't hit the tape yet. Earnings land 2026-09-30 (7 days out), with an 18.6% prior surprise, so this is a catalyst-dated read.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 是HR10170《存储芯片竞争力评估法案》最纯正的存储芯片标的 [bill_catalyst]。集群显示内部人买入满分（insider_mspr 100）、446项专利簇、Stocktwits 看涨比封顶（21.3万关注者中1.0），同时Ro Khanna的披露关联 [actor:Ro Khanna]，而股价仍相对标普-19.6——意味着散户/聪明钱的热情尚未反映在盘面上。财报将在2026-09-30落地（距今7天），前次意外超预期18.6%，这是一个有明确催化时点的判读。
second_order: AMAT — memory capex requires new equipment, directly feeding AMAT revenue
WDC/STX (off-pack HDD/NAND peers) — memory price cycle lifts all storage names
HUT — AI datacenter build-out absorbs memory modules for training clusters (per label_mismatch repoint)
evidence: [bill_catalyst] HR10170 Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act
theses.dissent: insider_mspr 100 can mean only one insider bought in a quiet window — a weak signal if it's a single small purchase. The stocktwits_bull 1.0 is retail sentiment that often tops just before a drawdown, and earnings in 7 days introduces binary event risk.

falsifier.text: Q4 earnings missing on DRAM/NAND pricing, or the memory bill stalling in House with no Commerce funding, would kill the read.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: SMCI's retail_buzz channel is loud (373 wsb_mentions) and the unusual_options put/call is 0.29 — extreme call-buying — but the insider_mspr is only 30.2 and the strongest independent channel, fundamentals, is absent. This is a retail-driven option frenzy not supported by the affiliation/government/patent channels that give other names their edge. The stock is +24.5 vs SPY, not yet flagged extended but trending that way.
theses.thesis_zh: SMCI的散户热度渠道很吵（wsb提及373次），非寻常期权put/call低至0.29——极度看涨买入——但内部人买入信号仅30.2，且最强独立渠道（基本面）缺席。这是一波由散户驱动的期权狂热，缺乏关联/政府/专利等支撑其他标的优势的渠道。股价相对标普+24.5，尚未标记为超涨但趋势指向那个方向。
second_order: NVDA — the AI server trade that SMCI rides is fundamentally NVDA's pull
AMD — competing AI server silicon means SMCI momentum can rotate quickly
theses.dissent: If insider_mspr is low but institutional flow is positive, the call-buying could be smart money front-running an AI-server earnings cycle. The missing channels lower conviction, not conclusion.

falsifier.text: Insider filings showing no meaningful purchases in the next 30 days while options volume fades would confirm the read.

theses.thesis: CAT is a value-laggard read: 13f_add, analyst_upgrade_cluster (1.0 bull), and a perfect insider_mspr 100, while the stock sits -28.2 vs SPY — deeply out of favor. The Water Resources Development Act of 2026 (HR9497) [bill_catalyst] is a direct infrastructure-spending catalyst. But the three channels are all 'cluster' or 'insider' types with no government contract or momentum behind them, so this is a WATCH, not an ACCUMULATE.
theses.thesis_zh: CAT 是一个价值落后标的的判读：13f加仓、分析师上调簇（1.0偏多）、内部人买入满分，而股价相对标普-28.2——深度失宠。《2026水资源开发法案》（HR9497）[bill_catalyst] 是直接的基础设施支出催化剂。但三大渠道都是'簇'或'内部人'类型，没有政府合同或动量的支撑，因此是WATCH而非ACCUMULATE。
second_order: DE — cyclical machinery peer benefits from the same infra/ag cycle
US steel/cement (off-pack) — construction inputs rise with infrastructure bills
evidence: [bill_catalyst] HR9497 Water Resources Development Act of 2026
theses.dissent: Insider_mspr 100 in a name with no price momentum could be a value-trap tell — insiders buying a falling knife while the infrastructure bill is a study-only authorization, not actual contract spend.

falsifier.text: HR9497 failing to appropriate actual construction dollars in the next 90 days, or CAT's next quarter showing no order backlog improvement, would break it.

theses.thesis: NVDA has the densest political-affiliation web in the pack: Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Michael McCaul all hold stakes [actor:Nancy Pelosi, actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, actor:Michael McCaul], Jensen Huang CONTROLS the company, and Jim Cramer TALKS_ABOUT it. Six independent channels align (affiliation, analyst_upgrade, github, patent, retail_buzz, special_situation) and it is NOT extended at +10.7 vs SPY. But the retail_buzz is high (207 wsb mentions) and the dpi_z is -0.7 — dark-pool flow is weak — so this is a WATCH: the political holdings are disclosed quarterly and could be stale, and the missing dark-pool confirmation cap conviction.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA拥有本组合中最密集的政治关联网络：佩洛西、格林、麦考尔均持股 [actor:Nancy Pelosi, actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, actor:Michael McCaul]，黄仁勋直接控制公司，Jim Cramer持续谈论。六大独立渠道共振（关联、分析师上调、GitHub、专利、散户热度、特殊情境），且相对标普+10.7并未超涨。但散户热度较高（wsb 207次提及），且暗池z值仅-0.7——缺乏暗池确认，故为WATCH：政治持仓为季度披露、可能滞后，暗池缺席压低置信度。
second_order: SMCI — NVDA芯片需求直接利好AI服务器集成商SMCI
MU — NVDA的AI训练集群需要大量HBM/DRAM存储
AMAT — NVDA驱动的AI资本开支推高设备订单
evidence: [affiliation] Pelosi, MTG, McCaul stakes; Jensen Huang CONTROLS
theses.dissent: dpi_z -0.7 means smart money is NOT accumulating through dark pools — the political stakes may be old news already priced in, and the retail buzz could be late-stage euphoria.

falsifier.text: Next dark-pool print still negative while retail mentions spike, or a major AI-capex customer cutting orders, would undermine the read.

theses.thesis: MRK is the one healthcare name where the channels are almost entirely regulatory/clinical rather than sentiment-driven: clinical_phase3_start (14 starts vs 5 halts), fda_label_expansion, and a cnbc_pick, plus a trump-linked buy side [trump]. The PROOF Act (HR10326) and Cancer Care Planning Act (HR10087) [bill_catalyst] are direct healthcare payment/oversight catalysts. The stock is +14.3 vs SPY — not extended — and the signal is precisely the kind of regulatory-pipeline alignment that pays over 60 days.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK是唯一一个渠道几乎全部来自监管/临床而非情绪驱动的医疗标的：临床三期启动（14项启动 vs 5项叫停）、FDA适应症扩展、CNBC关注，以及trump关联的买入侧 [trump]。《PROOF法案》（HR10326）和《癌症护理规划法案》（HR10087）[bill_catalyst] 是直接的医疗支付/监管催化。股价相对标普+14.3——未超涨——信号正是那种在60天周期内兑现的监管管线共振。
second_order: PFE/BMY (off-pack pharma peers) — same FDA/Medicare payment cycle
Healthcare services/Medicare Advantage (off-pack) — payment reforms lift the whole complex
evidence: [bill_catalyst] HR10326 PROOF Act + HR10087 Cancer Care Planning Act
theses.dissent: Trump-linked buy side is noisy — the administration's healthcare agenda is chaotic, and phase3 starts don't guarantee approvable data. The FDA label expansion could be a minor indication.

falsifier.text: A phase3 readout failure or the PROOF/Cancer bills dying in committee would remove the regulatory backbone.

theses.thesis: PLTR has the pack's highest weighted_score (2.55) and 6-channel convergence — but it's the definition of extended at +65.1 vs SPY, with retail_buzz (91 wsb) and stocktwits_bull both maxed out. The gov_contract_accel (54.62) is real [gov_contract_accel], and Marjorie Taylor Greene holds a stake [actor:MTG], but the entry is gone. This is a WATCH for pullback, not an accumulate.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR拥有本组合最高加权分（2.55）和6通道共振——但它是'超涨'的教科书定义：相对标普+65.1，散户热度（91 wsb）和Stocktwits看涨均封顶。政府合同加速（54.62）是真实的 [gov_contract_accel]，格林也持股 [actor:MTG]，但进场点已经没了。只适合回调时WATCH，不适合追入。
second_order: MSFT — PLTR's government/AI analytics work partners with Azure, lifting Microsoft's enterprise AI
BA — defense/government contracting complex; PLTR's gov-expansion signal is a canary for BA's defense orders
theses.dissent: The convergence is genuine — gov contract acceleration at 54.62 is extraordinary and could justify further upside for PLTR on a sovereign-AI wave. Avoiding is about entry risk, not thesis quality.

falsifier.text: A 15%+ pullback to non-extended territory would turn this from AVOID to a legitimate accumulation candidate.

theses.thesis: MSFT's channels are real but fully extended: +36.8 vs SPY locks out fresh money. The app_demand is off the charts (20M reviews, 4.77 rating), github_momentum is strong (192,785 stars), Sam Altman PARTNERS_WITH [actor:Sam Altman], and Trump is on the buy side [trump]. But all of this is priced. Watch for a mean-reversion entry.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的渠道真实但完全超涨：相对标普+36.8，新资金已被挡在门外。应用需求爆表（2020万条评论，4.77分）、GitHub动量强劲（192,785星）、Sam Altman合作 [actor:Sam Altman]、Trump买入侧 [trump]。但这一切都已反映在价格里。静待均值回归再进场。
second_order: NVDA — Azure/AI build-out accelerates NVDA datacenter GPU demand
PLTR — Azure partnership routes government AI contracts through MSFT
theses.dissent: Mega-cap AI leaders can stay extended for months; avoiding on rs_vs_spy alone may miss the sovereign-AI bid. But desk rules cap chasing extended names.

falsifier.text: A break below +20 vs SPY on macro de-risking would put MSFT back in the actionable zone.

theses.thesis: MMC shows gov_contract_accel 11.78 and news_sentiment 0.92 — quiet institutional accumulation in a non-extended name (+1.5 vs SPY). The special_situation channel is active but details are thin. This is a low-conviction WATCH: the contract acceleration is real but an order of magnitude lower than PLTR's, and there's no affiliation/insider confirmation.
theses.thesis_zh: MMC显示政府合同加速11.78、新闻情绪0.92——一只未超涨标的（相对标普+1.5）的安静机构吸纳。特殊情境渠道活跃但细节不足。低置信度WATCH：合同加速真实，但比PLTR低一个数量级，且缺乏关联/内部人确认。
second_order: BRK.B — insurance/brokerage complex; MMC's commercial-risk strength aligns with Berkshire's insurance holdings
AON/WLTW (off-pack peers) — insurance brokerage consolidators trade together
theses.dissent: 11.78 acceleration is modest for a government contractor; the special_situation may already be public news, leaving no edge.

falsifier.text: If the special_situation resolves with no follow-on contract growth in the next 60 days, the read is stale.

theses.thesis: BRK.B's cluster is thin but clean: 13f_add, affiliation (Warren Buffett CONTROLS [actor:Buffett]), and an 8-member congress_buy ($98.3M). No sentiment, no options, no patents — it's a pure ownership read. The stock is -4.5 vs SPY, not extended. This is a defensive WATCH: congressional accumulation in a Buffett-controlled name is meaningful, but two of the three channels are ownership-disclosure types with up to 45-day report lag.
theses.thesis_zh: BRK.B的簇虽薄但干净：13f加仓、关联（Warren Buffett控制 [actor:Buffett]）、8名议员买入（9830万美元）。无情绪、无期权、无专利——是纯所有权信号。股价相对标普-4.5，未超涨。防御性WATCH：国会增持巴菲特控制的标的是有意义的，但三渠道中两个是所有权披露类，最多滞后45天。
second_order: AAPL — Buffett's largest public holding; BRK.B accumulation signals continued confidence in AAPL
Financials/brokerage complex (off-pack) — Berkshire's insurance/bank holdings ride the same cycle
theses.dissent: Congress_buy of BRK.B may be a defensive hedge rather than alpha-seeking; the lag in 13f/congress disclosures means the 'signal' is up to a quarter old.

falsifier.text: Next 13F showing Buffett/BRK trimming its own buybacks or congress members selling in the next disclosure would reverse the read.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
track_record.calibration_note_zh: 尚无判断被评分 —— 待首批核查日到期后开始累积战绩；在此之前置信保持克制。
track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
